control_requirement: Data assets must be classified based on confidentiality privacy sensitivity and business impact
Only data necessary for the stated business purpose should be collected stored and processed
applies_when: Personal or sensitive data is processed

control_requirement: Access to personal and sensitive data must be restricted to authorised users based on business need
applies_when: Personal confidential or sensitive data is processed
evidence_required: Access review export and approval record

control_requirement: Personal sensitive or restricted data should be protected using encryption at rest and in transit
applies_when: Sensitive or restricted data is processed

control_requirement: Retention periods must be defined and reviewed for datasets containing personal or sensitive information
applies_when: Personal or sensitive data is retained
evidence_required: Retention schedule and disposal review evidence

control_requirement: Data location and cross-border processing arrangements should be understood and documented
applies_when: External sharing or third-party processing occurs
evidence_required: Data residency statement or vendor processing location evidence

control_requirement: External sharing of personal or sensitive data must be reviewed and approved
evidence_required: Approved sharing record DPA or vendor review evidence

control_requirement: A privacy impact review should be completed for high-risk personal or sensitive data processing
applies_when: Sensitive data high volume or new processing activity
evidence_required: DPIA checklist risk decision and approval evidence

control_requirement: Access to high-risk data assets should be monitored and reviewable
applies_when: Restricted or sensitive data is processed
evidence_required: Access logs monitoring configuration and review record

control_requirement: Unresolved privacy risks should have documented treatment decision owner and review date
applies_when: Privacy risk remains after controls are assessed
evidence_required: Risk acceptance or treatment decision record
